blocks.title: Probability
blocks.text: Probability (imkan) is ka mutala hai ke koi waqia hone ka kitna imkan hai. Yeh maloom baaton se nataij ka andaza lagane mein madad deti hai: probability = muwafiq nataij / kul nataij.

Sikka uchhalne ke do barabar imkan wale nataij hain, heads ya tails, to heads ka imkan 1/2 ya 50% aur tails ka bhi 50%. Probability mausam ki pesh-goi, karobari faislon aur cricket mein bhi istemal hoti hai. Statistics andaaz samajh kar sehat se marketing tak behtar faisle karne mein madad deti hai (Tip), aur rozana istemal hoti hai, maslan mausam ki khabron aur khel ke jaize mein (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Durust paase par 6 aane ka imkan kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 6 barabar imkan wale nataij mein se 1 muwafiq: 1/6, taqreeban 17%.

items: Probability = muwafiq / kul nataij; durust sikke par heads ka imkan 1/2.
